lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet already had grading, market, release/event, purchase and neural screen-priority functions, but the attached mobile workflow showed faster scan patterns: a market-focused home, visible capture readiness, compact region selection with map/list context, and a holdings summary. Existing tablet purchase UI required longer scanning and the portfolio surface was missing.
lessons.prevention_rule: Mount a separate reversible UI layer that consumes the existing V400 adaptive top-feature plan to reorder only derived home modules, displays market/release data as freshness/activity rather than invented direction, mirrors the existing camera engine's real exposure/focus/shake status, requests precise location only after an explicit user action and never persists coordinates, provides compact province/city/recent-region navigation plus a coordinate-distribution mini-map, and stores portfolio values locally using only user-entered prices.
validation_required: watched runtime changes are exactly VERIFY_TABLET_FINAL.sh, index.html, sw.js, tablet_runtime_manifest.py, tcg_updater.py, video_informed_tablet_ui_v403.css and video_informed_tablet_ui_v403.js
video-informed home order is derived from V400 screen_module_plan.top_features and respects the existing adaptive layout user preference
market TOP is explicitly activity/freshness priority and never claims a price direction or forecast without source evidence
capture preflight reflects existing cameraStatus exposure focus shake and automatic-capture progress rather than synthetic scores
precise geolocation is requested only by explicit button action and coordinates are not persisted
recent region labels and portfolio values remain local-only and are not uploaded
portfolio totals use only user-entered acquisition/current prices and do not auto-convert predicted grades into market value
new UI assets are mounted, service-worker cached, public-static served, runtime-manifest delivered and required by final tablet verification
existing 18-feature screen neural, champion/challenger, rollback, source/fact safety and physical-device boundaries remain unchanged
lessons.safety_boundary: The video-informed UI may reorder derived presentation modules from the existing verified neural plan, but it cannot invent market direction, prices, stock, release/event facts, grades or location. It cannot persist precise coordinates, upload portfolio values, generate source code, execute arbitrary commands, write Git/main or bypass verification.
